$comment: The theme gallery on /work/rift-ds: one entry per look the installed rift-ds package ships, in the order the gallery shows them. Each entry is the marketing dashboard template captured on rift-ds.com in that theme, light and dark, at website/public/images/rift-ds/themes/<id>-<light|dark>.webp. `id` is the package's own preset id (its data-brand value); `base` marks the one look with no preset stylesheet. scripts/validate-rift-ds-themes.mjs holds this file to the package's preset stylesheets and to the images on disk, both directions, so the count the page prints cannot drift from what the package ships. Re-shooting after a package upgrade restyles a template is the author's job, like the cover renders.

themes.label: Tide
themes.alt: The marketing dashboard in Tide, Rift DS's own look: teal bars and a teal primary button, set in Nunito Sans.

themes.label: Blueprint
themes.alt: The marketing dashboard in Blueprint: electric blue bars and buttons, set in IBM Plex Sans.
